raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

Format tensor shapes and array indexing as inline code in three MiniMax-M3 AMD docstrings, fixing the seven unresolved cross-references that abort strict API documentation builds.

Fixes #64469. The [failing Read the Docs build](https://app.readthedocs.org/projects/vllm/builds/35491049/) contains the original warnings.

## Claims

- Render the shapes and indexing literally, avoiding unintended `head`, `:n`, and `r` cross-references.
- Keep the change to three docstrings; the AST is identical after removing docstrings.

## Validation

Python 3.12.13 with the repository-pinned `requirements/docs.txt`:

```bash
READTHEDOCS_CANONICAL_URL=https://docs.vllm.ai/en/latest/ \
  .venv/bin/python -m mkdocs build --clean \
  --site-dir /tmp/vllm-docs --config-file mkdocs.yaml --strict
```

- Base `fa3b9d1377219247060d3c8b49eae199c9e7e154`: exit 1, reproducing all seven warnings (`head` ×2, `:n` ×4, `r` ×1); output: `Aborted with 7 warnings in strict mode!`.
- Patched tree, same command and dependencies: exit 0, zero MkDocs/autorefs warnings; output: `Documentation built in 112.08 seconds`.
- Generated HTML: all four affected shape/indexing expressions are rendered as `<code>` spans across the three API pages.

All applicable pre-commit hooks passed on the three changed files, including Ruff and mypy (Python 3.11 target). Hooks with no matching changed files were excluded from environment setup. `git diff --check` and a docstring-stripped AST comparison passed.

Hosted API documentation validation requires the `build-docs` label because this PR changes only `vllm/`; that label needs to be applied by a maintainer.

Hosted CI is currently blocked by the [pre-run-check contributor gate](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/actions/runs/40837548884/job/123325787669): it found one merged PR for the author, below the required four, and no accepted `verified`/`ready`/`ready-run-all-tests` label. Hosted pre-commit and formatting checks were skipped. [Read the Docs build 35491934](https://app.readthedocs.org/projects/vllm/builds/35491934/) was also skipped, so its success status is not a documentation build result. The local before/after strict-build evidence above is the completed validation.

## Details

Use the inline-code style already present in these docstrings. Searches for #64469 and related MiniMax docstring fixes found no existing implementation. AI assistance was used for implementation, validation, and this description.

---

<details>
<summary> Pull Request Checklist </summary>

- [x] I used vLLM's `/pr-checklist` skill. (Mandatory for agents, optional for humans).
- [x] AI assistance was used during the creation of this PR.
- [x] **Design Fit:** Minimizes impact on core components, reuses existing functionality, and justifies added complexity.
- [x] **Testing and Validation:** Validates the change and ensures any added tests are meaningful and reliable, with CI coverage or documented CI resource constraints and validation performed outside CI.
- [x] **Code Quality and Style:** Keeps code and comments clear and concise, and updates relevant documentation and examples.
- [x] **Pull Request Contents:** Includes a brief summary and relevant links, supports claims with evidence, explains root causes and implementation trade-offs, and follows the contributing guide.
</details>
